body.name: Finite rational response-sieve program
body.construction: On the rational boxes from \(\text{ass:rational-box-inputs}\), refine the semialgebraic coding cells from \(\text{ass:semialgebraic-code}\) to diameter at most \(h\) and compile every \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{rat}}\) mechanism, density, and query atom into finitely many rational polynomial and ReLU constraints. Introduce \(p_1,\ldots,p_K\), impose \(p_k\ge0\), \(\sum_{k=1}^Kp_k=1\), every finite-disjunct likelihood inequality in \(\text{def:exact-multinomial-region}\), and, for every \(k\), the coded-law equality \(p_{h,k}^{\mathrm{cert}}=p_k\). Each coding-cell or query integral is either replaced by its exact rational semialgebraic graph or evaluated through a certified inclusion-monotone rational enclosure; in the latter case both directed enclosure inequalities are retained so that every exact feasible point remains feasible and every objective interval contains its exact value. Together with the finite Lipschitz, density-mass, district-sharing, acyclic-recursion, and boundary-routing constraints, these clauses define \(S_h^{\mathrm{cert}}(p)\), \(p_h^{\mathrm{cert}}\), and \(Q_h^{\mathrm{cert}}\).
